zh: 經理會將任務分派給員工。

en: The committee approved the proposed budget unanimously.
zh: 委員會一致通過了預算提案。

en: Are you suggesting that I look fat in these pants?
zh: 你在暗示我穿這條褲子顯胖嗎？

en: Based on the data, we can conclude that sales have increased.
zh: 根據數據，我們可以斷定銷售額有增加。

en: Exams do not motivate a student to seek more knowledge.
zh: 考試不會激勵學生尋求更多知識。

en: The company's profits have shrunk significantly this year.
zh: 公司今年的利潤大幅縮水。

en: Please submit your application before the deadline.
zh: 請在截止日期前提交您的申請書。

en: The stunning view draws tourists from all over.
zh: 這壯麗的景色吸引著來自各地的遊客。

en: Don't forget to activate the alarm system when you leave.
zh: 離開時不要忘記啟動警報系統。

en: The company claims to have the best customer service.
zh: 該公司聲稱擁有最好的客戶服務。

en: I have been forced to adjust my schedule twice already.
zh: 我已經被迫調整我的日程安排兩次了。

en: Companies are always thinking of ways to promote products.
zh: 公司總在想辦法來促銷商品。

en: It took him two months to adapt to the new environment.
zh: 他用了兩個月的時間才適應了新環境。

en: They reached an agreement to settle the dispute.
zh: 他們達成了解決糾紛的協議。

en: In light of these changes, we must revise our plan.
zh: 鑑於這些變化，我們必須修改我們的計劃。

en: They decided to invest in real estate properties.
zh: 他們決定投資房地產。

en: The company is trying to locate a suitable office space.
zh: 公司正在努力尋找合適的辦公空間。

en: The scientist will demonstrate the experiment to the students.
zh: 科學家會向學生展示實驗。

en: The designer quoted $10,000 to redesign our living room.
zh: 設計師報價一萬美金來重新設計我家的客廳。

en: The company decided to demote him to assistant manager.
zh: 公司決定把他降職為副經理。

en: She went to the ATM to withdraw some cash.
zh: 她去自動取款機提取了一些現金。

en: The dispute is likely to dominate the news.
zh: 這場糾紛很可能成為新聞報導的焦點。

en: She went on to elaborate on her argument.
zh: 她繼續詳細說明她的論點。

en: The team was eliminated during the semi-final.
zh: 那支隊伍在半決賽中被淘汰出局。

en: I anticipate a positive outcome from the negotiations.
zh: 我預期協商將產出正面的結果。

en: The number of participants exceeded our expectations.
zh: 參加人數超出了我們的預期。

en: The president can appoint judges to the Supreme Court.
zh: 總統可以任命最高法院法官。

en: Our team can customize the software to meet your company's specific needs.
zh: 我們團隊可以依照貴公司的特定需求客製化這套軟體。

en: The location of the office was what appealed to him.
zh: 是辦公室的位置吸引了他。

en: He is committed to achieving his goals.
zh: 他致力於實現他的目標。

en: We need to sustain our efforts to achieve long-term success.
zh: 我們需要持續努力，以達到長遠的成功。

en: The construction workers will occupy the site next week.
zh: 建築工人下週將佔用該工地。

en: They will nominate her for the position of team leader.
zh: 他們將提名她擔任團隊領導者。

en: Can you distinguish between the two identical twins?
zh: 你能區分這對同卵雙胞胎嗎？

en: We converted the small bedroom into a second bathroom.
zh: 我們把小臥室改成第二間浴室。

en: Two companies decided to merge and form a new entity.
zh: 兩間公司決定合併並組成一間新公司。

en: You can track your package using the tracking number.
zh: 您可以使用追蹤單號，來追蹤您的包裹。

en: We charge a cancelation fee if you cancel last minute.
zh: 如果您在最後一刻取消，我們會收取取消費用。

en: He attempted to negotiate his salary with HR.
zh: 他試圖與人資部協商薪水。

en: The exhibition will allow new artists to exhibit their work.
zh: 那個展覽會讓新人藝術家展示他們的作品。

en: Please make sure to file all the documents in the cabinet.
zh: 請確保將所有文件歸檔至文件櫃中。

en: The safety of our employees concerns us greatly.
zh: 我們非常關心員工的安全。

en: The old copy machine has stopped functioning.
zh: 那台老舊的影印機已經停止運作了。

en: I need to purchase new office furniture.
zh: 我需要購買新的辦公家具。

en: The company guarantees the quality of their products.
zh: 公司對其產品的品質掛保證。

en: Please go to the front desk to register for the workshop.
zh: 請到櫃檯報名工作坊。

en: I decided to lease the car instead of purchasing it.
zh: 我決定租賃這輛車，而不是購買它。

en: Our classes feature hands-on and interactive activities.
zh: 我們的課程以實作及互動的活動為特色。

en: The settings will return to default after the update.
zh: 設定將在更新後回復為預設值。

en: The company will sponsor the upcoming event.
zh: 公司將贊助即將到來的活動。

en: The printer began to malfunction during the meeting.
zh: 印表機在會議期間開始故障。
